issues.evidence: f_23 enlarges soft chat text; f_24 leaves a large empty dark area beside the app; f_26 places 'It fixes.' partly over the document; f_28 truncates filenames and replacement descriptions.

issues.evidence: The film mixes red clocks, a neon-green check, cyan emphasis, glowing Send buttons, oversized white cursors and the red ellipse around 'Slide 4 title' in f_29.
issues.suggested_action: Use one annotation system with consistent stroke width, cursor scale and typography; assign red to unresolved discrepancies and cyan to review guidance, and remove decorative button glows.

issues.evidence: f_07 is dominated by a soft hand close-up; f_10 and f_13 repeat nearly the same centered head-in-hands composition. Measured sharpness is 3.1 at 15.6 seconds and 5.7 at 22.97 seconds.
issues.suggested_action: Replace the soft typing insert with a focused key or trackpad action and select distinct reaction moments from the existing protagonist footage, varying shot size while preserving her identity and lighting.

issues.evidence: f_03 and f_10 use blue office lighting, the illustrative interfaces are bright neutral white, the product captures are dark gray, and f_31–f_32 abruptly introduce a warm empty office window. Measured luma spread is 66.3.
issues.suggested_action: Match stock and screen surrounds to one cool office grade, preserve neutral screen whites, and bridge into the sunrise with the same desk or monitor visible in the preceding shot.

issues.evidence: f_20, f_21, f_33 and f_34 repeat centered bold white-and-cyan type over a teal glow; the logo is a white rounded square containing a blue document icon.
issues.suggested_action: Give the brand reveal a distinct composition derived from the three-file workspace, reduce the ambient glow and carry the same typography and spacing into a single restrained closing lockup.
